sources.content: # AGENTS.md: Lodemire. Lodemire is a feature store that serves precomputed machine learning features to online models with low latency. The repo has two parts: `core/`, written in Rust, and `sdk/`, a Python client. Build the core with `cargo build --release -p lodemire-core`. Install the SDK for development with `pip install -e sdk[dev]`. The local server listens on port 6460 and reads its settings from `lodemire.toml`. Run `scripts/smoke.sh` after any change to the read path; it fails if p99 latency goes above 15 milliseconds.

Rules. Feature names follow `entity.feature_name.version`, for example `user.days_active.v2`. Never change the meaning of an existing version; publish a new one. Python SDK code must support Python 3.9 and later, so do not use the match statement. Every pull request that touches `core/src/storage` needs a benchmark result pasted into its description. Secrets come from environment variables that start with `LODEMIRE_`; never read them from files in the repo. Keep the SDK free of heavy dependencies: numpy is allowed, pandas is not.

claims.text: The Lodemire core is written in Rust.
Lodemire feature names end with a version part.
Lodemire's local server listens on port 6460.
The Lodemire SDK may depend on pandas.
Lodemire's smoke script fails when p99 latency exceeds 15 milliseconds.
Lodemire SDK code must support Python 3.9 and later.
